dct_description_sm:
2015-2023 editions of the data. Mexico data is included in the 2019-2022 editions. Lithuania data is included in the 2020-2022 editions.

The 2023 edition of the data contains less countries than in any other version; countries included are Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Colombia, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy.

This table includes statistical projections on the energy balance for IEA countries by analyzing their respective products (coal, oil, nuclear, hydro, biofuels and more) in terms of flow. Data are expressed in thousand tonnes of oil equivalent(ktoe) and forecasts extend to 2030. [Data editions 2015-2023]
